title: DCPI-RWR: degree-conditioned pathway-integrated network diffusion for multicancer gene prioritization
description: Reproducible source code and publication-level derived results for a degree-conditioned, pathway-integrated network-diffusion framework that evaluates predictive discrimination against network-centrality dependence in time-separated multicancer gene prioritization.
notes: The immutable v1.0.0 software archive is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23307573.
